finding.claim: Path traversal in /dl: the 'f' query parameter is joined to the root directory without any containment check, so '../' sequences read arbitrary files outside /srv/files.
finding.sink: os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, name)) at files.go:13, with the contents written to the response at files.go:18

trace.note: filepath.Join(root, name) calls Clean, which resolves '..' segments and so lets the path escape /srv/files (e.g. f=../../etc/passwd -> /etc/passwd)
file contents are returned to the caller

finding.guards_checked: No prefix or containment check on the joined path, no filepath.Base, no allowlist, no authentication, and no symlink check. filepath.Join does not prevent traversal. The handler is registered directly at files.go:32 with no middleware.

verdict.reason: files.go:12-13 passes the unvalidated 'f' query value to filepath.Join(root, name) and os.ReadFile, Clean resolves '..' so f=../../etc/passwd escapes /srv/files, and files.go:18 returns the contents, with the handler registered unauthenticated at files.go:32 (only /avatar at files.go:22 uses filepath.Base).
